title: Need for Speed: Underground 2 reimplementation runs in browser with multiplayer
summary: Need for Speed: Underground 2 has been reimplemented as a browser-playable game at nfsu2.xyz, with working online multiplayer. Commenters say it runs on phones and desktop, and that Linux users need to enable unsafe WebGPU features in Chromium to play. The submission provides no architecture, source, or hosting details, and the site&\#x27;s legal status is unclear; commenters expect a takedown.
